review.images: Eight native project renders sourced from the District One West Phase 1 and Phase 2 brochures. The latter is the Gulf Life broker-hosted edition and retains a reproduction restriction in the brochure. Local review only. Phase names follow the captions; different-phase render assets stay identified by their source pages.
review.location: The project page supplies the six time estimates. Its blank map information and generic 25.03465565999243 map latitude are not a verified project entrance. Madena and ResaleDXB pins differ. The site uses named directions and the Phase 2 developer masterplan mirrored by DXB Off Plan. Phase 1 regional and site layouts are in the linked Phase 1 brochure, physical pages 11 and 25. Nakheel confirms the two phases at https://www.nakheel.com/en/construction-progress/district-one-west.
review.floorPlans: Visually verified all 33 Phase 1 sheets and 10 Phase 2 villa sheets, including mirrored variants, island basements, roof plans and published built-up versus total areas. Phase 2 physical page 6 is visibly labelled The Lagoon Villas, Type B. Some portal indexes label it Garden Villas, but the actual plan and phase masterplan agree on Lagoon Villa. Pages 6–8 have outline text, so the printed titles and totals were read visually.
